units.source: Study skid, not a nameplate. Outdoor H2 consumer. 3 ft flange rule. Exhaust not to hab. East face west of the 500 mm wall clear. Rev F: from (-3500, 8200). Clears FUEL_CELL overlap. 1100 mm all faces (nec_110_26_mm); 1300 mm to ZNBR2, 1500 mm to NOX_SCRUB, 1500 mm to the west wall line.

Study skid. H2 anode. O2 manifold stays on the south face, 7620 mm from BACKUP_GEN H2 flanges or a 1 h wall. Heat is Q4 water only. Rev F: from (-3300, 7600). South (O2) face 7700 mm north of BACKUP_GEN, meeting oxidizer_or_1h_mm by distance without a 1 h wall. 1100 mm all faces; 1921 mm to SOL_ARK_60K (above the 5 ft vent envelope).

Deferred train, outdoor west yard, south of ESS. Order 1 of 4. Not a hab bay. Size is BMED skid class, not a nameplate. Rev F: from (-4848, 2400). North end of the MeOH train; 600 mm to MEOH_SYNTH, 700 mm to the GEO_ORC pad.
Order 2. Downstream of fermenter. DMFC still deferred. Rev F: from (-4848, 1200). Clears MEOH_TANK overlap; 600 mm to MEOH_FC and MEOH_FERM.
Order 3. Flammable hold. NFPA 30 dike. Not under the roof tank. Rev F: from (-4848, 1600). East of MEOH_SYNTH, 600 mm aisle; NFPA 30 dike envelope not drawn.
Order 4. Last. Not the PEM H2 fuel cell. No bay inside L1.
